meta.purpose: Raw one-time consensus enrichment seed for hierarchy browse and dimensional search. Import as the starting tree; the coach edits the live copy afterward.
notes: Shared path levels apply to both rulesets. Only named-move leaves carry gi / no-gi / both.
This seed is raw consensus material for prototype organization (#26), not a final product tree.
seen_in on leaves records which consulted sources listed that name; absence does not mean the move is rare.
Uncategorized is a product browse bucket for citations with no node link; it is not a seed node.
cross_refs on leaves and some positions map BJJ finder names to judo and wrestling names from open sources.
crosswalk is a flat index of those mappings for prototype search and display.

license_notes: bjj-data data is CC BY 4.0: keep attribution when redistributing the reference file or derived vocabulary labels.
Wikipedia and Wikibooks text is CC BY-SA 4.0: share-alike applies to adapted text from those pages; this seed uses short common technique names as consensus labels rather than copying article prose.
Grapplepedia was consulted for coverage consensus only. Do not treat this seed as a Grapplepedia dump; its site license is not an open reuse grant.
BJJGraph (bjjgraph.org) is source-available noncommercial and was not copied into this seed.
The seed is finder-node labels only. It does not include lesson fields, instructional content, or video.
Kodokan judo and wrestling takedown pages on Wikipedia are CC BY-SA 4.0: short technique names used as cross-ref labels, not copied article prose.
Folkstyle Wrestling Wikibooks is CC BY-SA 3.0: position and move names used as cross-ref labels only.
Cross-refs link BJJ finder leaves to judo/wrestling names. They do not add a fourth path level or change gi/no-gi leaf rules.
